features.title: Keyboard shortcuts in settings sync
features.description:
Settings sync can now give your other accounts the same keyboard shortcuts. Open SYNC LAYOUT in the header, tick Also copy account settings and choose the account to copy from.

The whole account file is copied, so camera settings, chat channel lists and saved overview profiles go along too. It only runs while every EVE client is closed, and backs up the files first. Resolution, monitor, graphics and audio are never copied. With automatic sync on, shortcuts you change on any account but the source are overwritten when the last client closes, so change them on the source account.

images.caption: The SYNC LAYOUT window, with Also copy account settings ticked

features.title: Sync each profile within itself
features.description:
Settings sync can now keep a different layout per launcher profile. Open SYNC LAYOUT in the header, tick your other profiles under Also apply to, and choose "Sync each one within itself": every character in each profile gets your main character's layout from that same profile.

Profiles your main character has never logged in with are skipped and named, and everything is backed up first.

images.caption: The SYNC LAYOUT window, with Sync each one within itself chosen under Also apply to
